# FARMbloomington

> Restaurant in Bloomington, Indiana. Seasonal menus from Chef Daniel Orr, built on Southern Indiana farms, in the old Oddfellows building.

- Phone: (812) 323-0002
- Address: 108 E Kirkwood Ave, Bloomington, IN 47408
- Areas: Bloomington, Ellettsville, Spencer, Nashville, Martinsville
- Offers: Lunch in the Market Café; Weekend brunch; Dinner and small plates; Wood stone oven pizza; Garlic fries; Private parties
- Rating: 4.3 from 1375 Google reviews
